The working agreement

07 days to observe

YOU approve messages and handle decisions

No new software. No revenue promises. No live outreach from this prototype.

Keep the lane narrow

Clear rules make
a useful experiment.

Before the test

The owner sets the boundaries.

Hours, service area, exact messages, emergency instructions, and the person receiving handoffs.

During the test

The operator follows the lane.

Record context, use approved wording, and hand replies back. No pricing, scheduling, diagnosis, or emergency handling.

After the test

The evidence makes the case.

Review effort, replies, handoffs, friction, and willingness to pay to repeat the workflow.
